NEXUS 3200
 Brinell Hardness Tester
 SEMI - AUTOMATIC
1
SPECIFICATIONS
Hardness scales Brinell
Load application Load cell, closed loop, force feedback
Load range 62.5kgf - 3000kgf
Brinell microscope BIOS Brinell Indent Optical Scanner (BIOS-1, BIOS-2)
Electronic system High performance embedded micro system controller, MS Windows, automatic and manual measurement
Software IMPRESSIONSTM LT No. of tests, Mean, St. Deviation, Min., Max., Range, CP,
 CPk, individual readings list, storage memory, Dwell time,
Hardness conversion test force setting, scale selection, calibration etc.
Brinell scales Rockwell, Vickers, Brinell, Leeb and Tensile 2 scales simultaneously
 HBW 2.5/62.5, HBW 2.5/187.5, HBW 5/62.5, HBW 5/125, HBW 5/250, HBW 5/750,
Dwell time setting HBW 10/100, HBW 10/125, HBW 10/250, HBW 10/500, HBW 10/1000, HBW 10/1500,
Indenters HBW 10/3000
Test procedures Default 10 seconds, user defined 1 to 99 seconds
Standards Certified indenters (ISO / ASTM) available at choice
Statistics Automatic, loading, dwell/unloading
Test force tolerance Complies to or exceeds, ISO, ASTM, JIS (Nadcap) standards
 Total tests, max, min, average, range, standard deviation, all in real time after each test
 <0.5%
Display resolution 6.5" full color touch screen, embedded
Working height / throat depth 220mm / 220mm
Connectivity USB (4), UTP-RJ45-LAN, W-LAN, RS232
Operating temperature 10C to 35C, non-condensing
Humidity 10% to 90% non-condensing
Machine dimensions 190mm x 617mm x 790mm
Machine weight 130 kg
Power supply 100V AC to 240V AC, 50Hz/60Hz, single phase
STANDARD DELIVERY
 Wireless mouse and keyboard
 Fuse 2A (3 pcs)
 Power cable
 Four adjustable vibration dampers
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES & FEATURES
 Certified indenters (ASTM, DIN, ISO) Extra large testing table, 450mm x 350mm,
 Brinell indent optical scanners with T-slots
 Certified reference hardness blocks
 Custom anvils & testing tables
 (ASTM, DIN, ISO) Spring loaded workpiece clamping system
 Large testing table, 350mm x 250mm,
 with T-slots
